decisions.quote: The current findings replicated part but not all of the pattern observed in the original study.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly state an overall partial replication verdict ('replicated part but not all of the pattern observed in the original study') and contrast one replicated three-way interaction against a non-replicated age-by-race effect ('unlike the original study'). Subsequent support for the general theoretical hypothesis does not override this explicit mixed verdict on the original study's findings.
